definitions.accepted: validated canonical command recorded by scheduler response_accepted
definitions.applied: at least one trace control step uses the exact accepted command after acceptance
definitions.full_command_completion: observed supervisor steps equal requested duration; null without acceptance
definitions.horizon_censored: accepted command duration not fully observed before fixed horizon; not an infrastructure failure
definitions.expiry_observed: full duration followed by a recorded local_reflex control step; null without acceptance
definitions.expiry_horizon_censored: observation ends before the expected subsequent local fallback can be observed
definitions.local_detect_to_apply_ms: first trace local_reflex control_started_ns minus measured detector timestamp

interpretation: Runtime-given command reaffirms the same local support. Acceptance, application, complete duration, and observed expiry are distinct endpoints. No additional physical benefit or LLM-discovered control is inferred. Retain the original fixed horizon.
